jahresabschluss.metaTitle: Holding UG annual report without a tax advisor - UGtax
jahresabschluss.metaDescription: Generate your holding UG's annual report yourself: balance sheet, P&L, E-Bilanz (XBRL) and ELSTER submission. Free and open source.
jahresabschluss.h1: Holding UG annual report - without a tax advisor
jahresabschluss.intro: Your holding UG has few transactions, no employees, no VAT. Yet many founders pay 500-1,500 EUR per year to a tax advisor for an annual report that would fit on a single page.
jahresabschluss.h2Required: What does a holding UG have to file?
jahresabschluss.req1: E-Bilanz - balance sheet + P&L in XBRL format to the tax office (§5b EStG)
jahresabschluss.req3: Trade tax return (GewSt) - municipal rate × 3.5% base amount
jahresabschluss.req4: VAT return (USt) - under §19 small-business: all fields 0 EUR
jahresabschluss.req5: Federal Gazette (Bundesanzeiger) - public disclosure of the balance sheet (§325 HGB)
jahresabschluss.how1: Download a bank export (XML, CSV or XLSX from your bank)
jahresabschluss.how2: Upload to ugtax.de - transactions are automatically classified to SKR04
jahresabschluss.how3: Review the classification and correct as needed
jahresabschluss.how4: Download E-Bilanz, filing guide, journal, and Bundesanzeiger document
jahresabschluss.how5: Optional: submit the E-Bilanz directly via ELSTER (self-hosted with ERiC)
jahresabschluss.whoBody: UGtax is for micro-corporations (§267a HGB) with simple bookkeeping: holding UGs, asset-management UGs, UGs without employees. If you have standard VAT, hidden profit distributions, or transfer pricing, you need a tax advisor.

ebilanz.metaTitle: Create your UG's E-Bilanz yourself - UGtax
ebilanz.metaDescription: Generate the E-Bilanz (XBRL) for your UG yourself and submit it to the tax office. SKR04, HGB taxonomy, micro-corporation. Free.
ebilanz.intro: Since 2013, every company that prepares a balance sheet must submit it and the P&L electronically to the tax office (§5b EStG). The format is XBRL and submission goes through ELSTER.
ebilanz.whatBody: The E-Bilanz is the electronic version of your annual report in the standardized XBRL format (eXtensible Business Reporting Language). It contains the balance sheet positions per the HGB taxonomy and is submitted via the ELSTER interface of the German tax administration.
ebilanz.h2Taxonomy: Which taxonomy does a UG need?
ebilanz.taxonomyBody: UGtax uses the HGB taxonomy for micro-corporations (§267a HGB) with the SKR04 chart of accounts. The simplified structure covers the essential balance sheet positions: fixed assets, current assets, equity, liabilities, revenue, and expenses.
ebilanz.step1Body: Download the account statement as XML (camt.053), CSV or XLSX from your business bank account.
ebilanz.step2Body: UGtax recognizes common bookings automatically (IHK, bank fees, GmbH costs). Unrecognized entries can be classified manually or via AI.
ebilanz.step3Body: UGtax generates the XBRL file per the HGB taxonomy. You also get a filing guide with all ELSTER field numbers for KSt and GewSt.
ebilanz.step4Body: Directly from UGtax (self-hosted with ERiC) or via Mein ELSTER / steuerschroeder.de / myebilanz.de.
ebilanz.faq1Q: Can I really do the E-Bilanz myself?
ebilanz.faq1A: Yes, if your UG is a micro-corporation (few transactions, no employees, small-business VAT). UGtax walks you through the process.
ebilanz.faq2A: No. Your bank data is processed in memory only and deleted immediately after the request completes. No database, no logging.
ebilanz.faq3A: Nothing. UGtax is free and open source (MIT license). Optionally you can supply your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Google API key for AI classification.
